name: Tea Garden

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after 5 rounds (no maintenance in round 5)

categories.label: Victory Point track
categories.hint: VP already marked on the track during play (caravans, gardens, cups, etc.).

categories.label: Action cards
categories.hint: Sum of VP printed on the right side of all purchased Action cards.

categories.label: Emperor cards
categories.hint: Sum of end-game VP from your Emperor cards (see card text, each has a max count).

categories.label: River Navigation
categories.hint: VP of the River segment your Boat occupies (highest free space for the first to reach the end).

categories.label: Workers in Tea University centre
categories.labelVi: Thợ ở giữa Đại học Trà
categories.hint: 10 VP per Worker meeple in the centre.

categories.label: Workers on Tea University rim
categories.labelVi: Thợ ở vành Đại học Trà
categories.hint: VP printed at the section where your Worker on the outer rim stands.

categories.label: Top of Emperor track
categories.hint: 10 VP if you reached the topmost row.

categories.label: Same-colour Cup connections
categories.hint: Count same-colour connections across all rows: 1:1, 2:2, 3:4, 4:7, 5:11, 6:16, 7:22.

categories.label: Unused Scrolls and Emperor tokens
categories.labelVi: Cuộn giấy và token Hoàng đế chưa dùng
categories.hint: 1 VP per unused Scroll and Emperor token.

categories.label: Tea Leaves on board (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Lá trà trên bảng (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Total Tea Leaves on your player board.

categories.label: Fermented Tea Leaves (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Lá trà lên men (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Fermented Tea Leaves on your player board.

tiebreakers.description: Most Tea Leaves on player board
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only a third-party rulebook transcription (RulesPal) could be reached; official PDF/BGG pages were not accessible, so values are not verified against the printed rulebook. Emperor card end-game effects (all cards in deck/discard/hand count): fermented leaf 3 each max 6; fresh leaf 2 each max 9; flat 12; neutral Teapot Scroll 4 each max 4; Pagoda on board 3 each max 6; Caravan card 3 each max 6; 18 minus 1 per Starting card; River/Tea University/Cup symbol cards 3 each max 6; Teapot symbol cards 2 each max 9. Enter their sum in emperorCards. Solo mode not modelled.
